description: Well-maintained gate guardian at the INS Garuda main gate. Source WoI 2008; currency unverified.
Withdrawn first-batch Sea King seen on the airfield 2008. Source WoI 2008; status unverified.

Wikipedia Sea Hawk survivors list gives IN-154 as displayed at INS Garuda (WoI 2008 photographed a derelict unidentified Sea Hawk there believed to be IN154, IN195 or IN231, and Sainik Samachar showed one used for technical training). Wikipedia also lists IN-195 and IN-231 as stored at INS Garuda; those two are not recorded separately here pending confirmation. Source Wikipedia, WoI.
